pilot.label: Pilot retrofit

installation.name: Commissioning at an existing approved input
Connection consumables; approved input supplied by site owner

pilot.status: Conditional planning allowance, not a contractor quote
conditions: Site owner supplies an existing pole, mains power, permits and an approved fail-safe controller input.
No trenching, new lamps, traffic-lane closure, lift hire, new controller interface or product certification is included.
Existing software is reused; shared setup allowance is EUR2,000, not a new platform development budget.
Annual service delivery allowance is one EUR60 labour hour plus EUR20 spares; electricity is additional.
Small consumable spares are routine maintenance; major device replacements are budgeted separately in the lifecycle cash flows.
Indoor prototype camera in an enclosure still needs field validation; this budget does not certify an outdoor road product.

production.label: Production rollout

installation.name: Approved existing-controller integration allowance
installation.notes: No direct Arduino lamp switching. Supplier-approved fail-safe interface, installation approval, and controller access required.

production.status: Conservative planning allowance, not a contractor quote
conditions: Ranges are editable planning scenarios, not confidence intervals or contractor quotes. Maintenance excludes separately calculated electricity. Offline operation assumes no WAN subscription. Platform allowance is not a vendor selling price or certification quotation. New poles, signals, trenching, mains supply, major controller upgrades, permits, central hosting, additional cameras, and product certification may require substantial extra cost.

notes: Hardware prices are unchanged. Lower pilot cost comes from explicit reuse and installation assumptions, not claimed supplier discounts.
At 20% gross margin, sale price is delivery budget /0.8 and service fee is annual service delivery budget /0.8.
The pilot profile must not be advertised as the unconditional cost to install at every Turin crossing.
